claims.summary: For every prime p, over the compact base Q_{n,p} (n=2^l, l>=2, m=n+1 rows of l bits, v=(n+1)l) with accuracy h=3(p-1)l and complete one-level ENS blocks affine in the old bits: if the proper high blocks ((p-1)r>h(k+1)) are M coordinate blocks (input spans spanned by literals x_b-c_b, c_b in F_p) and either M<=k or, with r=3l(k+1)+1 and V=pv (V=v under consistent pins), M prod_{i<t}(1-(r-l i)/V)<=k-t for some 0<=t<=k-1, there is no ordinary-PC refutation through any D>=1 with 2k(D+1)-1<=n. So M such blocks are excluded through floor((n+1)/(2M))-1 when that is >=1, i.e. M<=(n+1)/4. Proof: a product of pinned literal factors in distinct rows (one per block, or the greedy choice over F_p literals) is a nonzero f in L_k with zero restriction to every high flat; the rest of the all-prime affine exclusion proof (literal cofactors, p-1 coefficient rows, weighted ceilings, signed row separation) is unchanged.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections (D>=2h+1 found unused and dropped, F_p greedy argument written out, ledger and choice paragraph).
claims.rationale: Extends the small-inventory degree range to every prime field, as an elementary cover at polynomial degree.
claims.next_action: Extend to non-coordinate flats by disjoint-support packing, and to the unary-PHP analogue.
